annotations.title: Find upcoming gatherings: tonight, this week, or any window

description: PURPOSE: Find upcoming Christian gatherings posted on The Living Bread (services, prayer nights, Bible studies, worship nights, meals, recovery groups), soonest first. WHEN TO USE: "something on tonight in Atlanta", "church events this week near Austin", "an online service I can join". WHEN NOT: church buildings: find_churches. Ongoing groups: find_communities. A person to pray with now, or Tables open now: find_people_to_pray_with. MODES (required parameters in brackets): tonight [city] the next hours in one city, matched as text (hours 1 to 36, default 12; country disambiguates). this_week [none] the next seven days within 250 km of lat and lng or city, online gatherings included (limit up to 20, default 10). any [none] a custom window (days 1 to 60, default 14) near a place or anywhere; online true lists only online gatherings; paged with limit and cursor. OUTPUT: mode, answered_by, and count, gatherings [{id, title, when_utc, where, distance_km, kind, online, good_for_a_first_visit, freshness}], the door to every gathering, next_cursor for any, and honest when nothing is held. BEHAVIOR: read only; reads live data. Times are UTC and are what hosts posted: freshness is scheduled with available_now false, never a confirmation it is happening; convert to the person's time before telling them. None returns count 0 and suggests online gatherings. The place words (never a user id) are logged anonymously. Parameters a mode does not use are ignored and named in ignored_params. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

city.description: A city: matched as text for tonight, geocoded for this_week and any. Required for tonight.

country.description: For tonight: country name or ISO code to disambiguate the city.

cursor.description: Opaque paging token: next_cursor from the previous answer of the same call. Omit for the first page.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, only if the person shared their location; pair with lng. Coordinates win over city.

limit.description: For this_week and any: maximum gatherings, 1 to 20.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, paired with lat.

mode.description: Which kind of answer: any, tonight, this_week. Each mode, and the parameters it needs, is explained in the description.

online.description: For any: true lists only gatherings joinable online from anywhere.

name: find_gatherings

answered_by.description: The implementation that answered (the same tool name the signed-in endpoint lists).

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

ignored_params.description: Parameters given that this mode does not use.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.
